# May 29, 1934

Section of Field Records

Report on H-5397

Chief of party R.W. Knox Surveyed in Apr.-June 1933

Protracted by A.J. Wollmar

Surveyed by R.W. Knox

Verified and inked by A.M. Uzefovich Soundings plotted by A.J. Wollmar

I. The records conform to the requirements of the beneral Instructions, except Vol. I page 38, positions 112b-113b, where the spacing of time was not indicated, property.

- The field plotting was completed to the extent prescribed in the General Instructions.
- The hydrography is incomplete, and the usual depth curves of one, two, three, five, and even ten fathoms can not be drawn for their full extention.
- The office cartographer inked MLLW line, and improved slightly, arcording to Topo. sheets 4825 and 4826, the shore line, done by the field party.
- The junction with adjacent sheet H-5396 was not made, as this sheet is not inked yet. The junction with adjacent sheet H-4559 was also not made. This sheet has scale 1: 120,000
- Remarks: Vol.2, p. 47, position 106e (205 m. S.W. of O Bum, Lat. 33°46') mentioned:

"Bending Ift, to avoid rock", there is no rock on Smooth sheet, Boat sheet, and

7. The quality of the work is fair.

Respectfully submitted

alexis M. Ugefovich
